contexts.text: See Adultery. AC 2755. AC 5059. AC 5394. SE 2843. SE 4563.
On the excrementitious Hells of those who have lived in mere pleasures. General article. AC 943. SE 3211. SE 3212.
The celestial acknowledge that in itself the human race is excrementitious...
It has been shown me by living experience, that, regarded in himself, a man and a Spirit, nay, an Angel, that is, the whole of his proprium, is the vilest excrement... AC 987:3.
The delight of hatreds and of adulteries, which, regarded in itself, is nothing but an excrementitious delight; and into which it is also turned in the other life.
The odour of the sphere of those who have indulged in mere pleasures, and have been in no charity and faith, is excrementitious.
It is as if excrement should say that it is pure gold.

They who have been rich, and have lived in magnificent palaces, making their Heaven to consist in such things, and have been devoid of conscience and charity... at last become excrementitious, and exhale a sphere of stinking teeth.

The delight (of the cupidities of the love of self and of the world) is in the other life turned into what is filthy and excrementitious, and... they perceive the stench of it to be most delightful. Illustrated.
When he is told that such delight (of hatred) ... is in the other life turned into what is filthily excrementitious and cadaverous...
(The love of self) is like filthy excrement, which dissipates and defiles every sweet odour.
These are among the excrementitious lymphs. Described.
They who relate to the excrementitious lymphs there. Described.
An excrementitious odour (came) from the Hell where are adulterers.
When there was an excrementitious odour commingled with a cadaverous one (it came) from a Hell where there are adulterers who are also cruel.
(Thoughts of those in the excrementitious Hell.)
They were carried down through the excrementitious ways (in the brain). SE 3718 1.2.
(These insidious adulterers there) pass the time in most filthy excrements. SE 4085.
But the meats which are hard... are detruded into the intestines, and at last into the rectum, where the first Hell is; and at last they are cast out, and become excrements...
The falsities and evils in which they are, in a spiritual sense, are nothing but urine and excrements.

They who are defiled with more earthly dregs are beneath these, in the region of the intestines; but the excrements themselves which are discharged correspond to the Hells which are called the excrementitious Hells.
There are some who relate to... the excrementitious things of the brain...

Evident from... the Hells which are called excrementitious, where there are adulterers who have had filthy pleasures as an end. Intolerable stenches are exhaled thence... but they who are in those Hells... love to live in these stenches. For they are like those animals which pass their time in carcases and excrements, and there have the delight of their life...
Hence it is that dung and excrement correspond to the evils which are in Hell...

They who have passed their life in mere pleasures, and have lived delicately, and have indulged the palate and the belly, loving these things as the summum bonum of life, in the other life love excrementitious things and privies; these are then a matter of delectation to them; because such pleasures are spiritual dirt. They shun places which are clean and devoid of dirt, because they are undelightful to them.
The varieties of their life are very numerous, carrying excrementitious dirt; for these are the things which correspond to such a life...
They directed my eyes to excrements, etc. SE 2852. SE 3024. SE 3403.
Under Excretion, see this reference.
Occurs. SE 3150.
On the excrementitious Hell. SE 3212.
Such a human race... can scarcely reason from the excrements of the intestines... and therefore they reason from the most filthy and vile excrements of the excrements. SE 3483:end. SE 3572.
At last, when they are taken out, they appear to themselves to be excrementitious...
In the sphere of goods they become more of what is excrementitious... than others.
Such possess the excrementitious pores of the sweat...
(Such) go into the most filthy excrements.
(They who make an insidious attack during the night) are thrust down into an excrementitious Hell.
They who in the life of the body have had no conscience; as adulterers and the cruel, become excrements...
On excrements.
He was shown where he was... in excrement...
Excrement () = the evil of the love of self.
The reason Ezekiel ate a cake of barley made with the excrements of an ox () was to represent that the truth and good of the Church was so... defiled by evils.
Nothing is more delightful than an excrementitious stink to those who have been addicted to the love of commanding; and also to those who have taken delight in adulteries, and none in marriages.
The excrements, by which are signified infernal things, were carried outside the camp ().
There are some in the excrementitious Hells, who have been given to variety...
